notes: All26 intended mathematical definitions match the v10 audited plan blocks exactly. No threshold, denominator, risk definition, contrast, confidence-interval method, bootstrap rule, Kitagawa term or replay comparison was changed.

Native display rows were independently grouped by their final equation number and compared against separately generated upright-label TeX. Arithmetic operators, fraction numerator/denominator scopes, superscripts/subscripts, logical conditions and row order are checked structurally. Only authorized style/run-font properties, delimiter-property serialization order and sum-limit placement are excluded.

Count names TP/FP/TN/FN and endpoint labels H1/H2/H3 are single literal identifiers with their index attached to the whole name. Upright dev/std/CPU/archive and operator labels are presentation corrections, not new scientific variables.
S7 uses one logical OR symbol (∨) between the same fixed/equal zero conditions; it does not introduce an AND or alter the four-category frequency definitions.
The long inline benign/malignant set becomes ordinary prose naming the same two strata. All inline mathematical objects were independently checked against that equivalent representation.

All66 main tablecells, all878 supplementary tablecells, main abstract, Results through final declarations/references/captions, and original supplementary scientific material remain exact, apart from the standalone S6 filename v6→v7. S6 PDF bytes and all24 production figure files are unchanged.
Final documents: formal main23 pages, reading28, supplementary29 and S6six. The separate formula proof has9 pages.

Content verification does not substitute for the separate strict visual-layout review. Selected actual equation pages and the final S7 condition were spot-inspected here; complete visual approval is reported by the dedicated layout reviewer.
No model inference, patient resampling, new data collection or statistical reanalysis was performed for this typography revision.
